system.summary: Two different keys: the Brulart de Leon cipher of 1615-18 (figures with diacritics) and the 1631 Sabran cipher (letters, digits and signs); both reconstructed by others.
system.sibling_key: Sabran cipher also in BnF fr. 4134, fr. 4135 (Lasry)
system.notes: System fields from DECODE metadata and Tomokiyo's pages, not checked here.

prior_solution.where: cryptiana.web.fc2.com louisxiii.htm and GL.htm (Tomokiyo; Lasry 2022); DECODE R2785/R2786 files

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched DECODE record views for R2748, R2785, R2786 and the four R2748 images with the shared cookie.

Checked Tomokiyo's louisxiii.htm (DECODE's pointer) and GL.htm: R2748 solved by Lasry 2022, R2785/R2786 read by Tomokiyo with a reconstructed key; Farnese 1637 (R2753, catalogue 192) solved by Lasry too.

outcome.method_basis: Nothing was read here: R2785/R2786 had been read by Tomokiyo with a reconstructed key (decryptions on DECODE, 2021) and R2748 solved by Lasry in 2022 (key images on cryptiana GL.htm); the session confirmed these from louisxiii.htm and GL.htm and closed the entry without applying either key.
outcome.notes: Nothing new; key not re-applied here. Catalogue entries 191 and 192 removed.
